<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Scoreboard</title>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="scoreboard" width="200" height="100"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('scoreboard');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        let playerA = 0;
        let playerB = 0;

        function drawScoreboard() {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            ctx.font = '20px Arial';
            ctx.fillText(`Player A: ${playerA}`, 10, 20);
            ctx.fillText(`Player B: ${playerB}`, canvas.width - 110, 20);
        }

        function updateScoreboard() {
            drawScoreboard();
        }

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'z') {
                // FACT line 14: playerA is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 36: existing code writes it as playerA = 0;
                // FACT line 15: playerB is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 37: existing code writes it as playerB = 0;
                // CHECK 6 FAILED: pressing z at the starting value does not go below it
                // CHECK 7 FAILED: a still works after z
// on this key: playerA is one lower. Ensure playerA never goes below 0.
                playerA = Math.max(0, playerA - 1);
                updateScoreboard();
            }
            if (e.key === '0') {
                // FACT line 14: playerA is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 30: existing code writes it as playerA++;
                // FACT line 15: playerB is declared `let`.
                // FACT line 33: existing code writes it as playerB++;
// on this key: every piece of state is back to its starting value.
// This is because the keydown event is triggered every time a key is pressed, and the state is reset to its initial value.
                playerA = 0;
                playerB = 0;
                updateScoreboard();
            }
            if (e.key === 'a') {
                playerA++;
                updateScoreboard();
            } else if (e.key === 'b') {
                playerB++;
                updateScoreboard();
            }
        });

        window.app = { state: () => ({ playerA, playerB }) };
    </script>
</body>
</html>
